targetBasis: existing raw OSM README bbox and delivered tree JSON meta.bbox, not a guessed runtime extent; Claude verifies current main uses same play area
verticalDatum: NAVD88 GEOID18 metres per USGS/NOAA dataset metadata; horizontal metadata describes NAD83(2011), TIFF encodes EPSG:26918: preserve/report this distinction; no survey-grade reprojection claim

candidate.method: 1m source samples aligned to integer-metre UTM reference using nearest (<0.00004m lattice shift), then mean of each 2x2 block, stored float32; runtime reconstruction evaluated bilinear

coverage.note: all 1m reference cells in padded rectangle valid, dense projected boundary inside two source extents; no extra DEM acquisition needed for established bbox

candidateErrorVs1m.method: bilinear reconstruct 2m candidate at every 1m reference pixel centre inside exact WGS84 bbox, absolute elevation difference; whole terrain incl banks/water is retained in audit

anchor.description: shared Glen Street / Bay Street / South Street node; a sourced geographic reference, not surveyed road-deck height
anchor.verticalRule: For unmodified terrain: gameY = DEM_NAVD88_m - anchor.demNAVD88M; Claude must reconcile actual current coordinate frame and road/bridge deck without silently moving xz geography.

license: USGS public-domain government work; credit USGS 3D Elevation Program
pointCloudNpzCaveat: dt_d22.npz is NOT a terrain grid. Arrays x,y,z,c,r,n,g; 4,562,339 mixed-class point records, x/y numerical range consistent with Web Mercator EPT but no embedded CRS/units metadata; do not use as an authoritative ground grid. Ground filtering/provenance would be necessary. 1m GeoTIFFs are used instead.

nativeDetailPatches.selection: 64x64m source blocks with candidate reconstruction error >0.25m anywhere, plus 8m halo; exact 1m aligned reference samples, no smoothing
nativeDetailPatches.notTerrainVoids: nodata outside refinement patches means use the separately supplied full-coverage base, NOT flat ground or missing source coverage
nativeDetailPatches.runtimeWarning: Claude must design/test continuous multiresolution ground/mesh/collision integration. No final composite error claim is made here; compare final runtime query/mesh to original source, especially seams.
